result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer has a 30-day convenience-termination right, receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, owes no early-termination charge, and Vendor receives no corresponding right. Existing termination rights are preserved. However, allowing termination “in part” goes beyond the stated playbook requirement and may create ambiguity regarding the scope of partial termination and fee allocation, so the change is not strictly minimal.
